en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a round stone tower or memorial building on a hilltop. The structure has a cylindrical body with small windows, a heavy cornice, and a crenellated upper section, all built of rough stone. A rectangular base with an entrance and steps leads up to it. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the entrance. Large flags with horizontal light–dark–light stripes fly on poles around the monument. Trees and a simple fence line the foreground.
